categories_thin: Mental health / therapy: Monroe has many solo LCSW/LPC/LSW practitioners listed only on Psychology Today and Zencare (individual profiles, often home or shared-suite addresses). Only group providers (Center for Wellness, JFS Monroe) are listed; solo clinicians were deliberately not enumerated one by one.

Wellness/alternative care (acupuncture, massage, reiki, nutrition): coverage is thin because most leads are NPI-registry entries or single directory pages with no website or recent reviews, and several appear to be home-based solo practices.

Personal care beyond hair/nails (esthetics, lash, brow, waxing): few listings surfaced that were not attached to a salon or med spa, suggesting the sub-category is small or mostly suites inside existing salons.
caveats: Distance: Monroe Township (08831) is large and runs south/east toward Englishtown and Millstone. Addresses on Englishtown Rd and NJ-33 in the southern/eastern part of the township (e.g. 1989 Englishtown Rd, 981 NJ-33, 957 NJ-33) sit at or slightly beyond the 10-mile straight-line edge from central Milltown and should be distance-checked by triage.

Chains and large health systems were excluded, including Kessler Rehabilitation Center, Penn Medicine Princeton Health outpatient therapy, Hackensack Meridian Urgent Care and Rehabilitation at Monroe, Carbon Health, Rutgers Health Monroe, Penn Princeton Primary Care, Family Practice of CentraState, AOSMI/Advanced Orthopedics, Ivy Rehab, Strive Physical Therapy (two Monroe sites), StretchLab, Beltone and AudioNova.
Several entries rest on a single bulk directory or map listing (noted in active_evidence) and need a liveness check - typical for older Yellow Pages, SuperPages, NPI and Loc8NearMe records.
Overlook Dr and Half Acre Rd addresses sit on the Monroe-Jamesburg boundary and sources disagree on the town label, so a few entries may officially be Jamesburg borough rather than Monroe Township.

No Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Cylex or Chamber of Commerce bulk directory page could be opened directly (Cloudflare 403 on yellowpages.com, chamberofcommerce.com and cylex.us.com; BBB search returned national results), so completeness rests on search-engine plus map-listing aggregation rather than one authoritative local directory.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API timed out from this environment, so no OSM cross-check of the zone was possible.
Monroe Township's official site has no searchable business directory; only a senior-services PDF and newsletters mention providers, and no licensed-business or economic-development list was found.
Psychology Today, Zencare and similar therapist directories were not paged through exhaustively, so dozens of solo mental-health practitioners in 08831 are not itemized.

Bing Maps returned only the top few results per query without sign-in; Google Maps gave a truncated 'limited view'. Deeper pagination of either map would likely surface additional salons, nail bars and small offices.
Many entries have no website recorded because none was seen linked from a listing; the triage team should look these up.
